blocks.title: Functions of the skeleton
blocks.md: The skeleton gives **support**, **protection** (the skull protects the brain, the ribs protect the heart and lungs), **movement** (bones act as levers), makes **blood cells** in the red bone marrow and **stores minerals** such as calcium and phosphate.

blocks.title: Joints
blocks.md:
A **joint** is where two bones meet. In a **synovial joint** (such as the knee) the bone ends are covered with smooth **cartilage**, enclosed in a capsule that makes **synovial fluid** to lubricate the joint. **Ligaments** join bone to bone; **tendons** join muscle to bone.

- **Ball-and-socket** (shoulder, hip): movement in all directions.
- **Hinge** (elbow, knee): movement in one plane only.

blocks.caption: The arm: antagonistic muscles at the elbow.
blocks.alt: A drawing of the upper arm and forearm meeting at the elbow, with the biceps above and the triceps below the humerus.

blocks.title: Antagonistic muscles
blocks.md:
Muscles can only **pull** (contract) and never push. They work in pairs that do opposite jobs: **antagonistic muscles**.

- To **bend** the arm: the **biceps contracts** and the triceps relaxes.
- To **straighten** it: the **triceps contracts** and the biceps relaxes.

Muscle tissue needs a good supply of oxygen and glucose for respiration.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Ligaments join *bone to bone*; tendons join *muscle to bone*.
- Muscles do not push: the opposite muscle pulls the bone back.
- Cartilage is not bone: it is smooth, flexible and covers bone ends.

blocks.title: Bend and straighten
blocks.statement: A girl lifts a bag of cassava from the ground with a bent arm and then lowers it with a straight arm. Which muscle contracts in each case?
steps: Bending the arm: the biceps contracts and the triceps relaxes.
Straightening the arm: the triceps contracts and the biceps relaxes.
blocks.answer: Biceps to bend, triceps to straighten.

blocks.title: Why the joint slides easily
blocks.statement: A footballer's knee moves smoothly for years. Name two features of the joint that allow this.
steps: Smooth cartilage covers the ends of the bones, reducing friction.
